title: fix(mcp): stdio list_datasets localizes the dataset catalogue for the workspace default locale
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBU5y97XtBcJ8qSLSR3B3Djd)_

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgwLiKcfujYUug7sPs

Closes #34787

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：stdio 通道的 `list_datasets` / `query_dataset` 读到的数据集，现在先用 HTTP 通道同一个翻译函数（`@objectstack/rest` 的 `translateMetaList`）按工作区默认语言翻译，再交给执行器展示和匹配。
- **为什么改**：ADR-0149 D2 规定数据集目录"在元数据边界按调用者语言本地化"，没有通道例外；之前默认语言为 zh-CN 的工作区，stdio 只显示英文标签，「总金额 / 平均成交额 / 阶段」一个都不命中，而 HTTP（不带语言头）全部按 `label` 命中。
- **风险与回滚**：`@objectstack/mcp` 新增对 `@objectstack/rest` 的运行时依赖（实测 `os` CLI 入口本来就加载它）；i18n 服务取不到时保持原来的未翻译列表。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/mcp/src/stdio-data-bridge.ts`（`loadDatasets` 的翻译步骤）、`packages/mcp/package.json`（新依赖）、`packages/mcp/vitest.config.ts`（两条源码 alias）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run src/stdio-data-bridge.dataset-locale.test.ts`，预期 4 个用例全部通过。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/mcp/src/stdio-data-bridge.ts`: the stdio bridge's `loadDatasets` (the one source both `list_datasets` and `query_dataset` read) now runs `translateMetaList(sources, 'dataset', items)` from `@objectstack/rest`, the call `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts` makes on the HTTP door. Its three sources mirror the HTTP door's: the i18n service (a resolver that throws or answers nothing means none), the merged protocol read for the packaged base (or none on a host without one), and `metaRequestLocale(undefined, i18n)` for the locale. With no request, that answers the i18n service's default, which is what the HTTP door answers for a call with no `Accept-Language`. No new locale source and no per-call locale.
- `StdioDataBridgeDeps` gains an optional `i18n?: () => unknown`, and `packages/mcp/src/plugin.ts` passes `() => optionalService('i18n')`, resolved at each use like the protocol and security services. `@objectstack/mcp` exports nothing new.
- `packages/mcp/package.json`: `@objectstack/rest` added to `dependencies`, `@objectstack/service-analytics` added to `devDependencies` (the test's stand-in executor matches terms with the platform's `matchDatasetTerms`). `pnpm-lock.yaml` adds the two importer links.
- `packages/mcp/vitest.config.ts`: anchored source aliases for `@objectstack/rest` and `@objectstack/service-analytics`. Without them, `check:test-source-alias` would need two new rows in its shrink-only ledger.
- `.changeset/34787-stdio-list-datasets-locale.md`: a patch for `@objectstack/mcp`.

Not touched: `dataset-term-matcher.ts`, matching other locales' bundle values (#34720's open fork), `candidates`, the HTTP door, and a per-call stdio locale.

### Translator route: import from `@objectstack/rest`

I measured two routes. Importing from `@objectstack/rest` was chosen over a thin wrapper around `translateMetadataDocument`:

- `translateMetaList` does more than call `translateMetadataDocument`. It also resolves the packaged base (`packagedObjectBaseOf`) and a declared override's pair bundle (`pairTranslationBundleOf`), and it applies the translate options (`metaTranslateOptions`: fallback chain and source locale). A wrapper would have to copy those or drop them. Either way the two transports would stop agreeing.
- Precedent: `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/invitation-role-label.ts` already imports `translateMetaList` from `@objectstack/rest`.
- No cycle: `@objectstack/rest` does not depend on `@objectstack/mcp` (`check:workspace-manifest-cycles` exit 0).
- Cost, measured from a real load of the built `packages/mcp/dist/index.js` (ESM, module-init set collected through `module.registerHooks`), at 3bbda33b and at this head:
  - before: 379 modules, 17 packages; after: 400 modules, 25 packages;
  - the 8 added packages are `@objectstack/rest`, `@objectstack/metadata`, `@objectstack/observability`, `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `chokidar`, `glob`, `js-yaml` and `readdirp`.
  - The built `packages/cli/dist/index.js` (the `os` host that runs the stdio transport) already loads all 8. `@objectstack/runtime` imports `@objectstack/rest` statically. So the cost falls only on a host that embeds `@objectstack/mcp` without the runtime.
  - `check:lean-entry-closure` guards only `@objectstack/objectql/core` and stays green.

## Why

ADR-0149 D2 says the `list_datasets` source is "localized at the metadata boundary for the caller's locale the way the REST door localizes a saved dataset". It names no transport exception. On #34720, live readings on a copy of app-crm with `i18n.defaultLocale: 'zh-CN'` showed the gap (comment 6945257866). The stdio door showed English labels and matched none of 总金额 / 平均成交额 / 阶段. HTTP with no header matched all three as `label`.

## Tests

`packages/mcp/src/stdio-data-bridge.dataset-locale.test.ts` (new). The bridge runs over a dataset with zh-CN bundle labels. A stand-in executor lists what the bridge loaded and runs the platform's `matchDatasetTerms` over it:

- zh-CN default: the catalogue shows 商机指标 / 阶段 / 总金额; 总金额 → `measures.total_amount · label`; 阶段 → `dimensions.stage · label`.
- `en` default: authored labels, and the zh-CN term does not hit (today's result).
- An i18n resolver that throws: the untranslated list, not an error.
- A host with no i18n service: the untranslated list.

Ablation (one-time proof, committed fix first, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`):

- The anchor `return Array.isArray(translated) ? translated : items;` was replaced by `return items; /* ABLATED-34787 */`. Landing was confirmed (anchor 1 → 0, blob `5dad1618` → `721eb27b`).
- With the mutation, the zh-CN case went red: `expected 'Opportunity Metrics' to be '商机指标'`, 1 failed and 3 passed.
- Restore: blob `5dad1618` equals the HEAD blob, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- The test reaches the bridge through a relative import, so no build or `dist/` sits on its path.

## Acceptance notes

- The stdio locale comes from the i18n service's `getDefaultLocale()`, as on the HTTP door with no header. The `EntryLocalization` that `plugin.ts` assembles for the stdio principal's `ExecutionContext` is not read here. On the readings below the two agreed.
- Error handling copies the HTTP door: only the service *resolution* falls back to the untranslated list. A resolved i18n service whose `getLocales` / `getTranslations` throws reaches `loadDatasets` as a throw on both transports. The executor answers that as a degraded read. That case is not pinned here.
- Because `query_dataset` resolves its dataset through the same loader, the provenance labels it prints over stdio are localized too. The HTTP door already behaves this way.
- Open #34814 also edits `stdio-data-bridge.ts`, in a different region. `overlap-check` reports it merges cleanly.

## Verification

All readings at head `f12cb94021` unless stated.

<details><summary>Unit tests and typecheck</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` (whole package, under the verify lock): Test Files 67 passed (67), Tests 1230 passed (1230), lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp typecheck`: exit 0, with `check:test-typecheck: OK`.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the four changed TypeScript files: exit 0. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

</details>

<details><summary>Live re-read: examples/app-crm copies, both transports, one boot each</summary>

Method: the worktree's own build, `os dev -p PORT` in a throwaway copy of `examples/app-crm` (deleted afterwards, never committed), and a persistent `OS_HOME`.

- Boot 1 minted an API key with `POST /api/v1/keys` as the seeded admin.
- Boot 2 used the same home with `OS_MCP_STDIO_ENABLED=true` and `OS_MCP_STDIO_API_KEY`. Over stdio it sent `initialize` and then `tools/call list_datasets`. Over HTTP, `POST /api/v1/mcp` with `x-api-key`.
- Terms: 总金额, 平均成交额, 阶段, 客户, Total Amount, total_amount, Avg Deal Size. `Avg Deal Size` is the authored label of `measures.avg_amount` and is not a member name.

Copy with `i18n.defaultLocale: 'zh-CN'`:

| Call | Catalogue labels | `matches` (crm_opportunity_metrics) |
|---|---|---|
| stdio | 商机指标 · 阶段 / 客户 / 成交日期 · 商机数 / 总金额 / 平均成交额 | 总金额 → measures.total_amount · label; 平均成交额 → measures.avg_amount · label; 阶段 → dimensions.stage · label; 客户 → dimensions.account · label; Total Amount → measures.total_amount · name; total_amount → measures.total_amount · name |
| HTTP, no `Accept-Language` | same as stdio | same as stdio |
| HTTP, `Accept-Language: en` | Opportunity Metrics · Stage / Account / Close Date · Opportunities / Total Amount / Avg Deal Size | 客户 → dimensions.account · synonym; Total Amount · name; total_amount · name; Avg Deal Size → measures.avg_amount · label |
| HTTP, `Accept-Language: zh-CN` | same as stdio | same as stdio |

Copy with `i18n.defaultLocale: 'en'` (unchanged app-crm config):

| Call | Catalogue labels | `matches` |
|---|---|---|
| stdio | Opportunity Metrics · English | 客户 → dimensions.account · synonym; Total Amount · name; total_amount · name; Avg Deal Size → measures.avg_amount · label |
| HTTP, no header | as stdio | as stdio |
| HTTP, `en` | as stdio | as stdio |
| HTTP, `zh-CN` | zh-CN | the six zh-CN-row hits |

`Avg Deal Size` misses on both transports under the zh-CN default and hits as `label` under the en default.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates: dispatch-gates --commands, reconciled with --ran</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 84 commands. All 84 were run locally, each with its exit code captured before any pipe.
- 83 exited 0. These include `check:test-source-alias` ("OK — 122 packages with tests scanned"), `check:undeclared-dep-imports`, `check:workspace-manifest-cycles`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:published-files` and `check:engine-double-contract`.
- NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: 14 packages outside this change have no `dist/` in this worktree. A direct `require('./packages/mcp/dist/index.cjs')` loads, exit 0. CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs the gate over a full build.
- `dispatch-gates --ran` with exit-annotated records: "84 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 83 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)", exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs`: exit 0.
- `overlap-check` against origin/main and the PRs that share paths (#34814, #34223, #33849): clean, exit 0.

</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; eslint is clean on the changed files (the repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 block is Chinese by the seat's template).
- [ ] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
